categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai RAAS Blood Products Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sales of blood products including human albumin, intravenous human immunoglobulin, specific immunoglobulins, and coagulation factor products. The company also operates through its subsidiaries in plasma collection and sales, and acts as an exclusive distributor for imported human albumin and blood screening products in mainland China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes biological and separation purification technologies to produce bioactive blood products from healthy human plasma. It employs advanced production quality management systems, including GMP compliance, automated production control systems (WINCC, WBS, WMS), and digitalized quality control processes. The firm also invests in R&D focusing on recombinant protein drugs and innovative therapies for hemophilia and coagulation disorders.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shanghai RAAS serves primarily domestic hospitals and healthcare institutions across China, targeting clinical needs in immunology, hematology, and emergency medicine. It also distributes imported blood products and diagnostic reagents to medical institutions. The company’s key customers include top-tier hospitals and government procurement agencies, with a growing presence in grassroots medical markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with plasma collection stations and subsidiaries in multiple provinces including Shanghai, Guangxi, Anhui, Zhejiang, Hunan, Guangdong, Shaanxi, and others. It also has export sales and maintains strategic partnerships with international entities, including Grifols in the US and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai RAAS operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the blood products supply chain. It controls plasma collection stations (upstream resource acquisition), blood product manufacturing (midstream), and distribution to medical institutions (downstream). It also acts as an exclusive agent for imported blood products, integrating upstream and downstream operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes expanding plasma resources through digitalized and smart plasma station management, enhancing R&D capabilities with a focus on coagulation and hemophilia treatments, and building a 'technology + market' ecosystem. It emphasizes innovation in product development, clinical application expansion, and digital transformation of quality management and marketing systems. Mergers and acquisitions are also a key growth driver.
categories.revenue_model: Shanghai RAAS generates revenue mainly through the sale of self-produced blood products and imported blood products under exclusive distribution agreements. Sales channels include direct sales to hospitals, commissioned distributors, government procurement, and overseas market expansion via authorized agents. The company also earns income from investments and licensing related to its equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest blood product manufacturers in China with a comprehensive product portfolio and high plasma utilization rate. It competes in a highly regulated industry with fewer than 30 domestic blood product producers. Its main competitors include other domestic blood product firms and international giants like Grifols, CSL, and Takeda. Shanghai RAAS is positioned as a leading domestic player with growing international cooperation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Shanghai RAAS reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.18 billion, representing a 2.67% increase from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 2.19 billion, showing significant growth. The company maintains a strong asset base with total equity exceeding RMB 31.9 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D and plasma station expansion, supporting steady growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai RAAS emphasizes product safety, quality, and efficacy, backed by strict GMP compliance and advanced digital quality management systems. It offers a broad and diversified product range, including some of the most comprehensive coagulation factor products in China. The company leverages innovation, clinical evidence, and academic marketing to meet unmet clinical needs, while its integrated plasma resource network and strategic partnerships provide competitive advantages.
